Responsibilities: Design, build, and optimize IT infrastructure solutions that meet business and performance requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field . 4–6 years of hands-on experience supporting and managing IT infrastructure—preferably in an ISP, enterprise, or outsourcing/BPO environment . Strong expertise with: Server operating systems (Windows/Linux) Network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) Virtualization technologies Backup, monitoring, and security tools Solid experience writing and maintaining technical documentation .
